SOC 11-2021

Marketing Managers by metro

Among Austin, Chicago, and Seattle, Marketing Managers have a published OEWS May 2025 annual median of $175,850 in Seattle, the highest in this slice. Published medians: Seattle $175,850, Chicago $165,340, Austin $164,920.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. bls.gov/oes. These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice.
